summary: Iter 4 chat feature (coach<->athlete real-time messaging) fully validated. 11 backend pytest cases pass (auth gating, send, conversations, thread, read-marking, bidirectional filter, sorting). Full UI flow validated on both coach & athlete sides + CV->Chat deep-link. Previous iterations regression: 38/38 pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1050 lines - approaching split threshold; consider extracting chat/messages router into a sub-module before next iteration.
App.js is ~1237 lines - same recommendation; ChatView (~lines 762-931) could be a separate file.
ChatView polling uses setInterval at 12s; cleanup confirmed via React effect cleanup (no observed leaks during navigation tests).
/api/conversations re-queries every 12s and pulls up to 2000 msgs into memory then groups in Python - acceptable now but will not scale; consider Mongo aggregation pipeline.
Cookie attributes (httponly, secure, samesite=none) correctly preserved for cross-origin Emergent preview.
test_credentials: Seeded fresh users per test run via mongosh (coach + athlete with session_token cookie). Cleaned up after tests.
seed_data_creation: Pytest fixture creates tec_pyt_<ts> + ath_pyt_<ts> with tokens and an athlete row. UI tests seed tec_ui_<ts> + ath_ui_<ts> with one inbound unread msg from athlete -> coach so the badge has something to show.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Chat backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_iter4_chat.py use a per-module mongosh fixture (creates+cleans users). UI auth is via cross-site session_token cookie - playwright must set cookie with domain=publish-perfected.preview.emergentagent.com, httpOnly=True, secure=True, sameSite='None' and navigate directly to /dashboard (not /). Polling interval is 12s, so badge clears either immediately after thread reload or after one poll - tests should allow ~13s slack on the second check.
